skill.summary: HTTP client for IServ school platforms. Log in to an IServ instance (e.g. https://grabbe-dt.de) and fetch common student data like unread mail counts, calendar events, files/folders, tasks/exercises, announcements/news, and other IServ modules via HTTP endpoints. Includes best-effort file ops + exercise submission.

latestVersion.changelog: Initial release: mail (IMAP/SMTP), calendar, files (best-effort), exercises (best-effort).
